title: Carnival and circus life, a storm that killed performers
summary: He toured in small shows through Louisiana, Texas and Mississippi, and survived a storm that killed performers by cutting through the tent.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Who was you playing with when the times got tough, hard and tough? Oh, anybody would pick me up. Cause we used to make up and go from one place to another. Like hustling, you know. Ask him how. Ask him how. One time down there at the state, didn't state. Ask him how. All through Nassie, which way, Oklahoma, and Tuxy, Little Rock. All through northern Mississippi. Just go from state to state, you know. And then we come back, you know. Then I got out of this, uh, then Convins. And, uh, you know them Convins, you know. Like a fair, you know. Convins. Convins, yeah. Yeah. We tried about that. And I gave it with me on one of them. You know, Little Joe would play piano. We always run together. So when they started playing on a bad tree, I would jump. And Joe went all the way to the ground. And then we'd come back. And then we'd come back, you know. And then we'd come back, you know. And then I got out of this, uh, the convent. And, uh, you know them convent, you know. You know, they're like a fair, you know. Yeah, a carnival. Convins, yeah. We'd try and about that. And I'd tell you, they'd be with me on one of them. And then we'd like to meet Joe Rubishow. Oh, they make a promise. She has to carry some there. I can give a beer, a baton room, they give us $35 a week. After they get that about twice, they wasn't getting anything they gave us, you see. Sometimes they didn't get nothing, you see. I know all about that. They give you big money, you see, in your home. And when you get around 300 and 400 miles away, they pay you like they want to pay you. Yeah. Then I'd try them at a show once, with them boys from up there. I don't know them so good, strangers. They're getting us all that day at them shows, you know. And they were boldest and large, you know. How many shows? That is hard too, man. How many shows a day? That's true about twice a day. They didn't come down, yeah. The closest place they come hit Alexander. All out of Lake Charles, Appaloosa, Burma Texas, Houston Texas, and different places like that, you know. They still had too much amusement in the city. They wouldn't make nothing. That's right. They were good, though, you see. I didn't come back here, but I didn't have to come back to write my mother a letter. Tell them coming home. They had the gate open. The little lice, the bottle lice, and the crab lice. And we was clean with them bunkers where we'd be performing, you know. They'd get in all the places. They'd be all in the chair, all this shit. All them things like they hit me up, huh? And then my mother got rid of them right away. I was wearing flannel then, you know. We used to be in that weather all the time, you know. Then the last year I was in Heckenbeth, Paul and Heckenbeth. I was, I believe I made it to Memphis, Tennessee. Then they'd come back to Baton Rouge. I'd take them sick. It was no more in there, you know. And they had to leave me in Baton Rouge. And my mother sent my sister for me and brought me home. She worked on me and got me all right. Then I went to go off with another little fella, small like me. He was a fire eater. And he said, if you all get together, it makes like we come from wild places. Like Africa and different things. But I was working with Atte. And he used to work with us too. But when his job run down, he went with his shoes. And he sent for me. But I told him, he said he was paying $50 a week. But I told him, I couldn't make it. He said, I was doing pretty good here, you know. We ain't making about $15 a week here. And chips, you know, like that. That's better to be, you know, make that home to be real. We wouldn't make nothing here. So they had a storm. And he got killed. And I said, if I had been with him, I think I'd have got killed. Because me and him were together. Poor fellas come back and used to work with us. They come back and told us that he had got killed. About 57 of the performers got killed, didn't they? That was the Clyde Beauty one time. Storm come up. Yeah. To everything else. Talk come right down on us. Big talk. Did it hurt you?
Me, I come out because I took my pocket knife and cut a hole and come on out through there. Sure.
That's an awful life on that road.
The women get so nervous, you know, and hollering so, they make him worse than what it is. Mm-hmm.
